task.title: Consume one retry generation in governed dispatch with audit

scope.owned_layer: Runtime-locked exact-generation consumption, governed queue reservation, failure-loop/chair integration, worker-start audit binding, and deterministic integration tests.
scope.not_changing: Pure V2 decision semantics, V3 failure/progress schemas, provider or reviewer policy, configuration, canonical task state, product controllers, and live services.

contract.progress_source: Newest exact governed reviewer reopen from the locked activity stream, normalized against the latest failure generation.
contract.admission: Both run_once and enabled worker self-claim read one non-mutating activity snapshot before runtime admission; the merged pure V2 decision is then re-evaluated from a fresh exact snapshot under runtime_state_lock immediately before the existing governed queue append.
contract.activity_snapshot: One cycle-scoped activity snapshot is threaded through poll, reassignment, chair, failure-loop, dispatch, and self-claim checks; no candidate or phase rereads the growing stream.
contract.one_shot: Runtime state and durable activity audit both retain the exact failure-recovery token; either source denies replay across loops or processes.
contract.queue_failure: Queue rejection, exception, or missing exact readback leaves the token consumed with an explicit fail-closed outcome.
contract.dispatch_key: The exact token extends the existing signed task dispatch key, permitting a newer governed generation without bypassing cooldown or queue identity.
contract.failure_loop: Automatic reassignment, task-agent blocking, and chair triage yield only for an allowed exact owner recovery; helper claims remain blocked for every threshold task.
contract.worker_start: Queue metadata carries only token and generation identities; worker start records the queue event and run ID and can reconstruct consumption from durable audit after a crash window.
contract.streak_retention: Consumption, queueing, worker start, and arbitrary active-worker commits do not clear the streak; later failures append and retain threshold state.
contract.audit: Redacted audit includes task/provider/owner/reviewer, prior count/kind/time, failure/progress generations, qualifying event/head, reason, token, queue identity, and worker run when available.

acceptance_coverage: failure-loop, reassignment, and chair-triage gate release
run_once and self-claim each perform one pre-lock activity read plus one fresh atomic-consume read
self-claim lock ordering and shared-snapshot decision reuse
worker start and crash-window audit reconstruction
all merged pure V2 deny rows

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest -q .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py -k 'FailureStreakRecoveryDispatchConsumptionV2 or FailureStreakRecoveryDecisionV2 or failure_loop'

review.note: Owner-authored evidence only. Independent exact-head Human/Ops review is required before merge.
